test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The __jovial__ host welcomed his guests with a warm smile and a hearty laugh.
solution: The correct answer is: **Petulant**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Jovial **means cheerful and friendly. (हँसमुख और मिलनसार) • **Example**: *Despite the challenges, he remained jovial, spreading cheer with his friendly and lighthearted demeanour.* • **Petulant** means easily irritated or annoyed. (आसानी से चिढ़ जाना या परेशान होना) • **Example**: *The child became petulant when her request was denied, displaying irritation and impatience.* Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Cheerful **means displaying happiness, optimism, or a positive disposition. (ख़ुशी, आशावाद, या सकारात्मक स्वभाव प्रदर्शित करना) • **Buoyant **means cheerful and optimistic. (प्रसन्नचित्त और आशावादी) • **Convivial **means friendly and lively. (मिलनसार और जीवंत) 3b:T9c3, The correct answer is: "**but it is impossible**."
